page.notes: The catchword "prii" is the first word of the next page and is printed at the bottom right. The running head is set in small capitals and is given here in capitals. Long s is normalised to plain s throughout (e.g. "fancitae" to "sancitae", "Pfeudo" to "Pseudo"). Hyphens are kept only where the printer broke a word at the line end.
